verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's architecture inherently replicates data across nodes and documents 'survival goals' and automatic failover surviving disk/machine/rack/datacenter failures without manual intervention (docs-7, docs-14/20/26, multiregion-overview), which covers HA/failover behavior well. However, this is distributed multi-active replication rather than classic 'read replicas', and community evidence notes that related read-scaling features (Follower-Reads) were moved behind an enterprise license, complicating a straightforward 'add read replicas' story. missing for 10: explicit read-replica configuration docs, hands-on failover test corroboration, and clarity on Follower-Reads licensing tier.
